subject: Emotions
title: Phobias and Disgust
description: A micro-lesson that makes Phobias and Disgust usable.

hook.text: Spider phobia isn't just fear—most spider-phobic people report disgust as the dominant emotion.

buildup.text: Spiders, snakes, and insects trigger both fear and disgust circuits simultaneously.

discovery.text: Graham Davey found that spider phobia correlates with disease avoidance, not danger avoidance.

twist.text: People fear spiders in countries where no dangerous spiders exist. The disgust signal overrides the facts.

climax.text: Treating the disgust component, not just the fear, improves phobia outcomes significantly.

punchline.text: Most phobias have a hidden disgust problem underneath.

quiz.question: What did Davey find about spider phobia?
